person.bio: Abeer Nasir is a Generative AI Specialist and Digital Marketing Specialist who helps e-commerce and D2C brands grow with Meta Ads, Shopify, and AI automation. He started learning Generative AI in 2023 and Meta Ads even earlier. Since then he has helped brands grow with practical, measured campaigns — running small-budget Meta Ads tests and lead-generation campaigns with documented outcomes. He believes in real numbers, not vanity metrics.
person.story: I started learning Generative AI in 2023 with one simple question: how can AI help businesses work better? I didn't have a traditional AI background and no fixed roadmap — so I learned by building. My first projects were rough, but each one taught me what actually works versus what just looks impressive. The learning curve was real: I broke campaigns, wrote weak prompts, and built automations that didn't fit how a business actually runs. Every mistake sharpened the next build. By 2024 I was taking on real clients — and that's where it clicked: businesses don't want 'AI for the sake of AI,' they want less manual work and more sales.

faq.q: What exactly does Open Agent do?
faq.a: Open Agent helps e-commerce and D2C brands grow with Meta Ads, Shopify, AI automation, AI agents, AI content and web development. Think of it as an AI-powered marketing partner founded by Abeer Nasir.

faq.q: Do you work with US-based businesses?
faq.a: Yes. Abeer works remotely with US e-commerce and D2C founders. Communication is over WhatsApp, email or video call, and deliverables are aligned to US time zones where needed.
Three transparent monthly plans: Starter PKR 30,000/mo, Premium PKR 50,000/mo (most popular), and Pro PKR 80,000/mo. No hidden fees. Every plan has a 4-day money-back guarantee.

faq.q: How long until we see results?
faq.a: Meta Ads campaigns typically show early signal in 1-2 weeks; meaningful ROAS data in 3-4 weeks. Automation and content work land faster — often within the first week.

faq.q: Do I need a big budget?
faq.a: No. Abeer has run small-budget Meta Ads tests for D2C brands on just PKR 1,000 and lead-generation tests for local services on PKR 2,000 — and small budgets force discipline, which converts better. Plans start at PKR 30,000/mo.

faq.q: Do you build chatbots and AI agents?
faq.a: Yes — custom chatbots and virtual assistants for support and lead generation, built on LLMs like ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. That's exactly what this chatbot is!
Karachi, Pakistan. Abeer works with clients worldwide remotely.
Fastest is WhatsApp at +92 370 3159642. Otherwise email (nasirmeo5533@gmail.com or abeerinfo5566@gmail.com) or the contact form on the website. Response within a few hours.
No lock-in. Open Agent starts with a clear project scope, then optimizes month by month. You can pause anytime.

faq.q: Can you help my perfume or beauty brand?
faq.a: Yes — Abeer has worked with e-commerce and D2C brands in perfume and beauty on Meta Ads, Shopify and content. It's one of his core niches.
Every plan has a 4-day money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied within the first 4 days, you get a full refund of the service fee, no questions asked.
